proves.claim: clause 1: clearReservation after reserveItem reads the reservation columns back as null.

moves.clear-reservation.removes-set-rese.why: A reservation that cannot be cleared would leave an item misrouted.

proves.claim: clause 2: clearReservation with no reservation refuses with a next step and changes nothing.

moves.clear-reservation.no-reservation-r.why: A silent clear on nothing would hide a wrong item id.

proves.claim: clause 3: an engine below RESERVATION_ENGINE refuses clearReservation with ENGINE_VERSION.

moves.clear-reservation.older-engine-ref.why: An old writer must not drop a reservation that replicas replay.
